lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh uv.lock weekly, merging once CI passes, so transitive dependencies reach the project without a direct pin (ADR 013 in todofixthis/cookiecutter-py).

packageRules.description: Never bump Python: an agent session rotates it with the rotate-python-versions skill, which also removes compat code (ADR 015 in todofixthis/cookiecutter-py).
Bump the Renovate validator pin monthly, merging once gate passes: Renovate releases several times a day (ADR 025 in todofixthis/cookiecutter-py).
